gap_definitions.T: No direct arbitrary text-input control in program cards; preset strings are possible.
gap_definitions.I: No authorized learner-image binding and decoding/resampling path into these helpers; bundled images and numeric pixels are possible.
gap_definitions.M: No general connection from a card interaction to genuine trained-model inference, activations, embeddings or attention outputs; supplied/synthetic values are possible.
gap_definitions.E: No external process, filesystem, network service, GPU or framework execution inside the card sandbox; small local simulations are possible.
gap_definitions.H: Numeric pixel output is bounded to 64 × 64 per raster and 8192 pixels per frame; detailed high-resolution generated/edited pixel output needs a different path.
gap_definitions.V: Authentic data, model parameters, traces, source artifacts or a dated authoritative specification must be supplied. This is an evidence dependency, not automatically a missing UI component.
gap_definitions.D: The richer variant crosses an owner-deferred capability. Recorded only as a boundary; it is not a recommendation or reopened task.
gap_definitions.X: True 3D interaction is outside /interact by owner decision. A 2D projection or schematic can still explain part of the topic.
